frame_sequence: Continuous actual-distance phase. Every full cycle moves forward through stance, lift, swing, touchdown; no reverse playback. Original four bitmap keys retained as source archive only.
registration: Whole original native frame-zero silhouette retained. Anatomical source leg regions use UV skinning; body remains the original painting. No source pixels redrawn or downsampled.

gait.description: Original frame-zero painted body AND native fur/hoof/paw pixels, deformed with registered anatomical UV leg meshes. No synthetic flat-painted limbs.
